section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch) AT-57

content.description: Hands removing one-way clutch from outer race

content.text: 13. REMOVE ONE-WAY CLUTCH FROM OUTER RACE
Note the direction of the one-way clutch.

content.description: Hands holding clutch piston assembly with air pressure tool

content.text: INSPECTION OF OVERDRIVE INPUT SHAFT AND CLUTCH

items: (a) Check that check ball is free by shaking the piston.
(b) Check that the valve does not leak by applying low-pressure compressed air.

content.text: Check that the sliding surface of disc is not worn or burnt.
If the disc is worn or burnt, replace disc.
Then check that the sliding surfaces of plate and flange are not worn or burnt.
NOTE: Do not allow the discs to dry out. Prepare new discs by soaking them at least two hours in ATF.

content.description: Overdrive input shaft assembly showing four plugs installation

content.text: ASSEMBLY OF OVERDRIVE INPUT SHAFT AND CLUTCH

items: (a) Coat parts with petroleum jelly to hold them in place.
(b) Slide bearing and then thrust washer facing lip outward.

content.description: Hands installing one-way clutch into outer race

items: (a) Install the one-way clutch into the outer race.
(b) Install a retainer on both sides of the one-way clutch.
